schema_notes: Strict JSON; no comments required by the build tool.
Stable collection/evidence/trigger/interaction IDs are persistence identifiers and must never be renumbered.

The 153 readable-document budget covers the 27 budgeted collections. Four additional trigger documents belong to unbudgeted collections, so the integrated authored document registry contains 157 readable records.
Trigger effects are machine-readable operations; physical interactions are a separate effect source.
Ambient interactions never alter persistent investigation state.
Site orientation is baked into canonical JSON geometry; runtime Site rendering must not apply the former 90-degree presentation transform.
Furniture back-edge rotations are expressed in final player-facing Site axes. Full Site spreadsheet border directions are rotated into those axes before being stored.

Act II branch documents are mutually gated by workstream availability: both are initially selectable, the unchosen branch is deferred after selection, and T-028 releases the alternate workstream after Act II core completion.

documents.title: Disk Recovery Index
documents.body:
DISK 144 RECOVERY INDEX

The medium contains a partial archive of a Government Department of Records Site during its final closure period. Recoverable material includes administrative records, reconstructed rooms, physical-object references and cross-linked evidence.

The archive is incomplete by design. Restore collections, inspect reconstructed physical material and distinguish what the archive claims from what the surviving physical record can establish.

WHAT VERSION OF THE TRUTH ARE YOU WILLING TO ACCEPT?

documents.title: Terminal Access & Command Reference
documents.body:
GDR ARCHIVE RECOVERY TERMINAL

INITIATE starts archive services for the current recovery. LIST shows collections currently available. RESTORE <CODE> reconstructs an available collection, subject to available recovery capacity. OPEN <RECORD-ID> opens a recovered readable record. EXIT returns to the reconstructed Site.

Commands operate only on material present on Disk 144. A missing record is not evidence that the original record never existed.

documents.title: Collection Restoration
documents.body:
COLLECTION RESTORATION

Recovered collections contribute reconstruction data to the Site. Restoration is persistent for the current recovery and cannot be undone. The available collection pool intentionally exceeds one complete recovery, so choices made during the session can change which material becomes available before Disk 144 is full.

Restoration reconstructs archived state. It does not invent absent information.

documents.title: Listing & Opening Records
documents.body:
LISTING & OPENING RECORDS

LIST presents the collections known to the recovery environment. Each restored collection may contain generated catalogue entries and a smaller number of readable authored records. OPEN accepts a stable record identifier.

Catalogue metadata may survive even where document content does not. Such entries are shown as unavailable rather than silently reconstructed.

evidence.statement: The manual-discharge control remained physically connected.
evidence.notebook_entry: The manual-discharge control remained physically connected.

evidence.statement: The Halon suppression system was deliberately kept operational during final Site closure.
evidence.notebook_entry: The Halon suppression system was deliberately kept operational during final Site closure.

evidence.statement: Archive reconciliation and terminal-network remediation both remained outstanding when final Site handover was attempted.
evidence.notebook_entry: Archive reconciliation and terminal-network remediation both remained outstanding when final Site handover was attempted.

evidence.statement: A record absent from its registered cabinet was still present in the Records Office on the Records Trolley awaiting refiling.
evidence.notebook_entry: A record absent from its registered cabinet was still present in the Records Office on the Records Trolley awaiting refiling.

evidence.statement: Some archive holdings were deliberately withdrawn from cabinet storage and staged for transfer.
evidence.notebook_entry: Some archive holdings were deliberately withdrawn from cabinet storage and staged for transfer.

evidence.statement: The Senior Archivist personally held responsibility for resolving outstanding transfer exceptions before handover.
evidence.notebook_entry: The Senior Archivist personally held responsibility for resolving outstanding transfer exceptions before handover.

evidence.statement: The Office Terminal remained operational; its network connection failed upstream of the local terminal.
evidence.notebook_entry: The Office Terminal remained operational; its network connection failed upstream of the local terminal.

evidence.statement: The Office Terminal circuit was correctly patched through IT Support and continued toward the Server Room.
evidence.notebook_entry: The Office Terminal circuit was correctly patched through IT Support and continued toward the Server Room.

evidence.statement: Digital verification work had been prepared but could not proceed while the affected network route remained unavailable.
evidence.notebook_entry: Digital verification work had been prepared but could not proceed while the affected network route remained unavailable.

evidence.statement: Final closure was suspended pending Operational Security review and completion of the remaining handover work.
evidence.notebook_entry: Final closure was suspended pending Operational Security review and completion of the remaining handover work.

evidence.statement: The Site closure was an authorised centralisation and digital-transition project rather than an exceptional security shutdown.
evidence.notebook_entry: The Site closure was an authorised centralisation and digital-transition project rather than an exceptional security shutdown.

evidence.statement: IT Support held standing Server Room access; the Senior Archivist held temporary authorised access for final archive-verification work.
evidence.notebook_entry: IT Support held standing Server Room access; the Senior Archivist held temporary authorised access for final archive-verification work.

evidence.statement: Reception and Security records contain no unexplained visitor access to the restricted areas during the relevant period.
evidence.notebook_entry: Reception and Security records contain no unexplained visitor access to the restricted areas during the relevant period.

evidence.statement: The relevant staff were recorded as present on Site on the final Friday and their duty status was consistent with their assigned work.
evidence.notebook_entry: The relevant staff were recorded as present on Site on the final Friday and their duty status was consistent with their assigned work.

evidence.statement: The Halon discharge triggered the Site evacuation; all personnel were accounted for and no injuries were recorded.
evidence.notebook_entry: The Halon discharge triggered the Site evacuation; all personnel were accounted for and no injuries were recorded.

evidence.statement: The Senior Archivist was present in the Server Room area when the evacuation occurred and was evacuated safely.
evidence.notebook_entry: The Senior Archivist was present in the Server Room area when the evacuation occurred and was evacuated safely.

evidence.statement: CCTV and Security duty records show expected staff activity around IT Support immediately before the incident, with no unexplained entry recorded; CCTV did not cover the protected Server Room interior.
evidence.notebook_entry: CCTV and Security duty records show expected staff activity around IT Support immediately before the incident, with no unexplained entry recorded; CCTV did not cover the protected Server Room interior.

evidence.statement: Environmental monitoring recorded the Halon discharge and automatic ventilation isolation, but no preceding fire condition was detected.
evidence.notebook_entry: Environmental monitoring recorded the Halon discharge and automatic ventilation isolation, but no preceding fire condition was detected.

evidence.statement: Server infrastructure remained operational to support final backups and archive verification during Site closure.
evidence.notebook_entry: Server infrastructure remained operational to support final backups and archive verification during Site closure.

evidence.statement: Network remediation was physically underway at the Server Room cable riser immediately before the incident.
evidence.notebook_entry: Network remediation was physically underway at the Server Room cable riser immediately before the incident.

evidence.statement: The still-connected manual-discharge wiring ran through the same cable-riser work area being disturbed during network remediation.
evidence.notebook_entry: The still-connected manual-discharge wiring ran through the same cable-riser work area being disturbed during network remediation.

evidence.statement: Suppression diagnostics recorded a manual-release input at the time of the Halon discharge rather than a release initiated by fire detection.
evidence.notebook_entry: Suppression diagnostics recorded a manual-release input at the time of the Halon discharge rather than a release initiated by fire detection.

evidence.statement: Physical cable condition and suppression diagnostics establish that disturbance of the still-connected manual-discharge circuit during cable remediation generated the release input.

ambient_interactions.title: STAFF SOCIAL NOTICE: DETAILS TO FOLLOW ONCE SOMEBODY FINDS THE FORM USED TO AUTHORISE DETAILS.
ambient_interactions.text: A drawing pin holds up an entirely blank reply slip.

ambient_interactions.title: Coffee machine
ambient_interactions.text: The coffee machine bubbles with the determination of a small industrial process. A handwritten sticker reads: DESCALING IS A COLLECTIVE RESPONSIBILITY.

ambient_interactions.title: Staff fridge
ambient_interactions.text: The fridge contains labelled milk, one mouldy cheese sandwich and a territorial system of shelves that no surviving policy document fully explains.

ambient_interactions.title: Half-finished crossword
ambient_interactions.text: 14 across: “Administrative delay, eleven letters.” Somebody has written BUREAUCRACY, counted again, and left the clue unfinished.

ambient_interactions.title: Completed crossword
ambient_interactions.text: Every answer is filled in. The final clue has been answered “PENDING”, which does not fit but has been awarded a tick anyway.

ambient_interactions.title: Labelled milk bottle
ambient_interactions.text: Label: “M. HARGREAVES. MONDAY. THIS MEANS YOU, TREVOR.” The milk has outlived the dispute.

ambient_interactions.title: Ancient first-aid manual
ambient_interactions.text: The manual strongly recommends techniques that the modern world has since reconsidered. A later reader has added: “Perhaps ring Security first.”

ambient_interactions.title: Forgotten umbrella
ambient_interactions.text: A perfectly serviceable umbrella, labelled only “NOT SIMON’S”. Nobody named Simon appears in the nearby staffing material.

ambient_interactions.title: Birthday card
ambient_interactions.text: The card has been signed by almost everyone. One signature simply reads: “Many happy returns, subject to retention policy.”
